data.name: الرَّحْمَنُ
data.reflection: His mercy embraces all of creation — every breath you take is a sign of Ar-Rahman. Call upon Him when you feel alone; His mercy is closer to you than your own heartbeat.

data.name: الرَّحِيمُ
data.reflection: His mercy is specially reserved for the believers. When you repent with sincerity, say 'Ya Raheem' — He pours mercy on those who turn to Him, no matter how far they've strayed.

data.name: الْمَلِكُ
data.reflection: He owns everything in the heavens and the earth, yet He cares for you personally. Surrender your worries to the true King — no one can take away what Al-Malik has gifted you.

data.name: الْقُدُّوسُ
data.reflection: He is free from all imperfection and weakness. When you feel stained by sin, call upon Al-Quddus — only the Purest can purify a heart that genuinely turns back to Him.

data.name: السَّلاَمُ
data.reflection: True peace flows only from Him. When anxiety overwhelms you, call upon As-Salaam and ask Him to place serenity in your heart — the One who named Himself Peace will not deny you peace.

data.name: الْمُؤْمِنُ
data.reflection: He is the One who grants faith and makes it firm in your heart. When doubt creeps in, ask Al-Mu'min to strengthen your iman — He planted it there, and only He can protect it.

data.name: الْمُهَيْمِنُ
data.reflection: He watches over all creation with perfect care. You are never unprotected — call upon Al-Muhaymin when you feel vulnerable, and trust in His unseen guardianship over your life.

data.name: الْعَزِيزُ
data.reflection: His might is unmatched and His honor is unassailable. When you feel powerless, remember the One you call upon is Al-Azeez — He can change your situation in a single moment.

data.name: الْجَبَّارُ
data.reflection: He mends what is broken and compels what He wills. When your heart feels shattered, call upon Al-Jabbaar — He specializes in putting broken pieces back together, more beautifully than before.

data.name: الْمُتَكَبِّرُ
data.reflection: He alone possesses true greatness and majesty. Humble yourself before Al-Mutakabbir — He will elevate you in ways that no human effort ever could.

data.name: الْخَالِقُ
data.reflection: He created you with intention and purpose. When you feel lost or worthless, call upon Al-Khaaliq — the One who made you knows exactly what you need and where you belong.

data.name: الْبَارِئُ
data.reflection: He designed your life with intricate order and balance. When chaos surrounds you, call upon Al-Baari — He can bring harmony from the most tangled situations in your life.

data.name: الْمُصَوِّرُ
data.reflection: He gave you your unique form and beauty with His own hands. When you struggle with self-worth or body image, remember Al-Musawwir shaped you deliberately — you are His masterpiece.

data.name: الْغَفَّارُ
data.reflection: He forgives again and again, without tire. No matter how many times you stumble, call upon Al-Ghaffaar — His forgiveness is an ocean that never runs dry.

data.name: الْقَهَّارُ
data.reflection: He subdues all hardship, oppression, and tyranny. When you feel crushed by circumstances, call upon Al-Qahhaar to break what binds you — nothing can resist His will.

data.name: الْوَهَّابُ
data.reflection: He gives without being asked and without limit. When you feel lacking in any part of your life, call upon Al-Wahhaab — He loves to give, especially to those who ask with empty hands.

data.name: الرَّزَّاقُ
data.reflection: He provides for every living creature, seen and unseen. When you worry about your future, remember Ar-Razzaaq has been sustaining you since before you were even born.

data.name: الْفَتَّاحُ
data.reflection: He opens doors that no human hand can unlock. When you feel stuck at a dead end, call upon Al-Fattaah — He will reveal paths you never knew existed.

data.name: اَلْعَلِيْمُ
data.reflection: He knows your pain before you can even articulate it. You never need to explain yourself to Allah — Al-'Aleem already understands, and He cares more than anyone ever could.

data.name: الْقَابِضُ
data.reflection: He tightens your circumstances when there is wisdom in it. When life feels suffocating, trust Al-Qaabid — every constriction is preparing you for a vast expansion.

data.name: الْبَاسِطُ
data.reflection: He expands your heart and your provision after every difficulty. When you feel relief is far away, call upon Al-Baasit — He is the One who promises ease after every hardship.

data.name: الْخَافِضُ
data.reflection: He humbles those who carry pride in their hearts. Seek refuge in Al-Khaafid from arrogance — ask Him to keep you grounded and protect you from being among those He lowers.

data.name: الرَّافِعُ
data.reflection: He elevates whom He wills to heights you can't imagine. Stop chasing status — call upon Ar-Raafi' and let Him raise your rank in this world and the next.

data.name: الْمُعِزُّ
data.reflection: True honour comes only from His hand. When the world dishonours you, know that Al-Mu'iz can grant you a dignity that no human can ever take away.

data.name: المُذِلُّ
data.reflection: He alone decides who is humbled, and why. Never take pride in another's downfall, and always seek His protection from humiliation — it is entirely in His hands.

data.name: السَّمِيعُ
data.reflection: He hears every whisper, every silent tear, every unspoken thought. When you feel unheard by the entire world, call upon As-Samee' — He hears you perfectly, always.

data.name: الْبَصِيرُ
data.reflection: He sees what no human eye can perceive. When you suffer in secret and no one notices, take comfort — Al-Baseer sees your pain and will not let it go unaddressed.

data.name: الْحَكَمُ
data.reflection: His judgment is perfect and never unjust. When life feels deeply unfair, surrender to Al-Hakam — His ruling is always ultimately in your favour, even when you can't see it yet.

data.name: الْعَدْلُ
data.reflection: He never wrongs anyone, not even by the weight of an atom. When you've been treated unjustly, trust Al-'Adl to settle every account with perfect fairness — in this life or the next.

data.name: اللَّطِيفُ
data.reflection: He works in your life through ways so subtle you barely notice. When you can't see how things will work out, trust Al-Lateef — His quiet plans are already unfolding around you.

data.name: الْخَبِيرُ
data.reflection: He knows every hidden detail of your situation — your fears, your hopes, your silent struggles. You don't need to have it all figured out; Al-Khabeer already does.

data.name: الْحَلِيمُ
data.reflection: He is patient with you despite your repeated mistakes. When you feel too broken or too sinful to return, remember Al-Haleem doesn't rush to punish — He gives you time, again and again.

data.name: الْعَظِيمُ
data.reflection: His magnificence is beyond what any mind can grasp. When you feel small and insignificant, stand before Al-'Azeem in prayer and feel how vast His presence truly is.

data.name: الْغَفُورُ
data.reflection: He not only forgives but conceals your sins from others. When shame grips you, call upon Al-Ghafoor — He covers your faults and treats you as though they never happened.

data.name: الشَّكُورُ
data.reflection: He gives you even more when you thank Him for what you already have. Even your gratitude is a gift from Him — yet Ash-Shakoor rewards you for it. That's how generous He is.

data.name: الْعَلِيُّ
data.reflection: He is above all, yet closer to you than your jugular vein. Call upon Al-'Aliyy and find comfort in this beautiful paradox — the Most High is also the Most Near.

data.name: الْكَبِيرُ
data.reflection: His greatness makes every problem appear small. When your worries feel enormous, place them before Al-Kabeer and watch them shrink in the light of His greatness.

data.name: الْحَفِيظُ
data.reflection: He preserves your deeds, your memories, and your soul. Your good deeds are never lost — Al-Hafeez guards what you cannot protect and remembers what you've forgotten.

data.name: المُقيِت
data.reflection: He nourishes both body and soul. When you feel spiritually empty and drained, call upon Al-Muqeet to feed your heart with what truly sustains — His remembrance and His love.

data.name: الْحسِيبُ
data.reflection: He suffices you in every situation and will account for all things. When people wrong you, say 'Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel' — Al-Haseeb is enough for you, always.

data.name: الْجَلِيلُ
data.reflection: His majesty demands awe and reverence. When you rush through prayer without presence, remember Al-Jaleel deserves your fullest attention — stand before Him as if you can truly see Him.

data.name: الْكَرِيمُ
data.reflection: His generosity has no bounds and no conditions. When you feel utterly undeserving, that's exactly when Al-Kareem loves to give most — His generosity is not something you earn.

data.name: الرَّقِيبُ
data.reflection: He watches over you with love, not surveillance. You are never truly alone — Ar-Raqeeb sees every struggle, every tear, and every sincere effort you make.

data.name: الْمُجِيبُ
data.reflection: He answers every call, in His own way and perfect timing. When du'a feels unanswered, trust Al-Mujeeb — He is responding, even if the answer hasn't reached you yet.

data.name: الْوَاسِعُ
data.reflection: His mercy and knowledge encompass everything without limit. No situation is too complex for Al-Waasi' — He holds space for every contradiction, every mess, every broken piece of you.

data.name: الْحَكِيمُ
data.reflection: There is profound wisdom behind everything He does and allows. When you can't understand why something happened, trust Al-Hakeem — every puzzle piece fits perfectly in His plan.

data.name: الْوَدُودُ
data.reflection: He loves you more than any mother ever could. When you feel unlovable or rejected, call upon Al-Wudood — His love for you is unconditional, eternal, and never runs out.

data.name: الْمَجِيدُ
data.reflection: His glory shines through every blessing in your life. When you notice beauty in the world — a sunset, a kind word — know it's a reflection of Al-Majeed's glory reaching you.

data.name: الْبَاعِثُ
data.reflection: He will bring you back to life after death. Live each day knowing Al-Baa'ith gives your actions eternal weight — nothing you do sincerely for Him is ever wasted.

data.name: الشَّهِيدُ
data.reflection: He witnesses everything — every injustice done to you, every truth you've spoken. When no one believes your side of the story, rest in the knowledge that Ash-Shaheed is the ultimate witness.

data.name: الْحَقُّ
data.reflection: He is the only unchanging reality in an impermanent world. When everything in life feels uncertain and shifting, anchor yourself to Al-Haqq — He is the one truth that never fades.

data.name: الْوَكِيلُ
data.reflection: He is the best disposer of affairs — better than you, better than anyone. When you've tried everything and nothing works, hand it all to Al-Wakeel and let Him handle what you can't.

data.name: الْقَوِيُّ
data.reflection: All strength originates from Him alone. When you feel physically, emotionally, or spiritually weak, call upon Al-Qawiyy — He will lend you strength you didn't know you could access.

data.name: الْمَتِينُ
data.reflection: His power is firm, unyielding, and unbreakable. When you need steadfastness and resolve, call upon Al-Mateen to make you unshakeable in the face of every trial.

data.name: الْوَلِيُّ
data.reflection: He is the protector and ally of those who believe. When you feel defenseless and exposed, call upon Al-Waliyy — no guardian is greater, no ally is stronger than Him.

data.name: الْحَمِيدُ
data.reflection: He is worthy of all praise, yet He praises His righteous servants. When you feel worthless, remember Al-Hameed sees value in you that He Himself acknowledges and praises.

data.name: الْمُحْصِي
data.reflection: He counts and records everything — nothing escapes His book. Every small good deed you've forgotten, Al-Muhsi remembers — nothing you do for Him is ever lost.

data.name: الْمُبْدِئُ
data.reflection: He began all creation from absolutely nothing. When starting fresh feels impossible, call upon Al-Mubdi — the One who started everything can certainly start your new chapter.

data.name: الْمُعِيدُ
data.reflection: He can restore what was lost, broken, or taken away. When you've lost hope, health, or relationships, call upon Al-Mu'eed — He specializes in bringing things back to life.

data.name: الْمُحْيِي
data.reflection: He breathes life into every living moment. When you feel spiritually dead inside, ask Al-Muhiy to revive your heart — He who gives life to dead lands can certainly revive you.

data.name: اَلْمُمِيتُ
data.reflection: He alone determines when each life ends. Remembering Al-Mumeet helps you live each day with urgency and purpose — death is not a punishment, it is a return to Him.

data.name: الْحَيُّ
data.reflection: He never sleeps, never tires, never fades. When you feel abandoned at 3 AM, remember Al-Hayy is fully awake, fully present, and fully there with you in your darkest hour.

data.name: الْقَيُّومُ
data.reflection: He sustains all of existence while needing no one to sustain Him. You depend completely on Him — yet He, who needs nothing, chooses to care for you. That is Al-Qayyoom's love.

data.name: الْوَاجِدُ
data.reflection: He finds what is lost and is never lost Himself. When you've lost your way — spiritually, emotionally, or literally — call upon Al-Waajid; He finds His servants even in the darkest places.

data.name: الْمَاجِدُ
data.reflection: His glory is inherent, eternal, and radiant. When you feel ordinary and invisible, remember you serve Al-Maajid — your connection to Him makes your life extraordinary.

data.name: الْواحِدُ
data.reflection: He is one in His essence, His power, and His authority. When you feel torn between worldly loyalties, call upon Al-Waahid to unify your heart around Him alone.

data.name: اَلاَحَدُ
data.reflection: He is uniquely one — there is none like Him, none comparable to Him. When you feel fragmented and pulled apart, call upon Al-Ahad to make you whole — oneness is His nature.

data.name: الصَّمَدُ
data.reflection: All of creation turns to Him for every need, yet He needs nothing from anyone. When everyone lets you down, As-Samad is the one you can truly, completely depend on.

data.name: الْقَادِرُ
data.reflection: He has the power to do anything, change anything, create anything. When something feels utterly impossible, remember Al-Qaadir — your 'impossible' is effortless for Him.

data.name: الْمُقْتَدِرُ
data.reflection: He didn't just have power — He created power itself. When people seem powerful and you feel helpless, know that Al-Muqtadir can strip their power in a single instant.

data.name: الْمُقَدِّمُ
data.reflection: He brings forward what He wills, ahead of its time. When you feel behind in life, call upon Al-Muqaddim — He can accelerate your journey in ways you never planned or expected.

data.name: الْمُؤَخِّرُ
data.reflection: He delays with perfect wisdom and purpose. When you're impatient for something you desperately want, trust Al-Mu'akhir — the delay might be protecting you from something you can't see.

data.name: الأوَّلُ
data.reflection: He was before everything — before time, before creation, before you. When you feel forgotten, remember Al-Awwal knew you before the universe existed. He hasn't forgotten you.

data.name: الآخِرُ
data.reflection: He remains after everything and everyone passes away. When you fear loss — of people, of status, of yourself — anchor to Al-Aakhir; everything else fades, but He remains forever.

data.name: الظَّاهِرُ
data.reflection: His signs are visible everywhere — in every sunrise, every heartbeat, every answered prayer. When you feel distant from Allah, look around; Az-Zaahir is evident in everything you see.

data.name: الْبَاطِنُ
data.reflection: He is hidden from your eyes yet closer than your breath. When you can't feel Allah's presence, trust Al-Baatin — He is there, intimately near, even when He is unseen.

data.name: الْوَالِي
data.reflection: He governs the affairs of the entire universe with perfect precision. When the world feels chaotic and out of control, remember Al-Waali is in charge — nothing happens without His permission.

data.name: الْمُتَعَالِي
data.reflection: He is far above every limitation, weakness, and flaw. When people put ceilings on your potential, remember you belong to Al-Muta'ali — no limit can contain what He has planned for you.

data.name: الْبَرُّ
data.reflection: He does good to all of creation, even to those who never ask. When you feel undeserving of kindness, Al-Barr is already sending good your way — simply because that is who He is.

data.name: التَّوَابُ
data.reflection: He constantly turns you back toward Himself. When you feel too far gone to ever return, call upon At-Tawwaab — He loves the moment you turn back far more than you love the sin that took you away.

data.name: الْمُنْتَقِمُ
data.reflection: He takes precise retribution on behalf of the oppressed. When you've been deeply wronged and have no power to fight back, leave it to Al-Muntaqim — His justice is flawless and inevitable.

data.name: العَفُوُّ
data.reflection: He doesn't just forgive — He wipes your sins away as if they never existed. When you can't forgive yourself, call upon Al-Afuww; He erases what you can't stop remembering.

data.name: الرَّؤُوفُ
data.reflection: He is gentle, tender, and compassionate in how He deals with you. When you expect harshness after your mistakes, Ar-Ra'oof surprises you with warmth and tenderness instead.

data.name: مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ
data.reflection: He owns the heavens, the earth, and everything in between. When you feel possessive over worldly things, remember Maalik Ul Mulk — you own nothing, but through Him, you have everything.

data.name: ذُوالْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ
data.transliteration: Dhu Al Jalaali Wa Al Ikraam
data.reflection: He combines awe-inspiring majesty with overflowing generosity. Approach Him with reverence and receive from His bounty — with Allah, you never have to choose between fear and love.

data.name: الْمُقْسِطُ
data.reflection: He establishes perfect balance and fairness in all things. When life feels deeply lopsided and unfair, trust Al-Muqsit to restore equilibrium — His scale never tilts without reason.

data.name: الْجَامِعُ
data.reflection: He will gather all creation on the Day of Judgment. When you feel separated from those you love — by distance, by death, by misunderstanding — Al-Jaami' promises a reunion beyond this world.

data.name: الْغَنِيُّ
data.reflection: He is completely and eternally free of all needs. When you feel needy and dependent on people, remember Al-Ghaniyy needs nothing — yet He still chose to care for you.

data.name: الْمُغْنِي
data.reflection: He enriches whom He wills with true wealth. When you feel empty inside, call upon Al-Mughni — real richness isn't in your bank account, it's the contentment only He can place in your heart.

data.name: اَلْمَانِعُ
data.reflection: He withholds from you what would ultimately harm you. When something you desperately want is denied, trust Al-Maani' — He is protecting you from a harm your eyes cannot yet see.

data.name: الضَّارَّ
data.reflection: He allows harm only with deep, hidden wisdom. When you face hardship, don't despair — Ad-Daarr permits it only to purify you, strengthen you, or elevate you to a place you couldn't reach otherwise.

data.name: النَّافِعُ
data.reflection: All benefit — every good thing in your life — ultimately comes from Him. When something wonderful happens, attribute it to An-Naafi' — recognizing the true source multiplies the blessing.

data.name: النُّورُ
data.reflection: He is the light of the heavens and the earth. When darkness surrounds you — grief, confusion, depression, fear — call upon An-Noor to illuminate your path and brighten your heart.

data.name: الْهَادِي
data.reflection: He guides whom He wills to the straight path. When you're unsure which direction to take — in life, in career, in relationships — ask Al-Haadi; He will place guidance quietly in your heart.

data.name: الْبَدِيعُ
data.reflection: He creates without any precedent, model, or blueprint. When you feel stuck and see no way forward, call upon Al-Badi' — He can create a completely new path that never existed before.

data.name: اَلْبَاقِي
data.reflection: He remains when everything and everyone else perishes. When you fear losing what you love, hold onto Al-Baaqi — what is connected to the Everlasting One never truly ends.

data.name: الْوَارِثُ
data.reflection: He inherits all things after their possessors pass away. When you're afraid of losing what you love, remember Al-Waarith — everything returns to Him, and one day, so will you.

data.name: الرَّشِيدُ
data.reflection: He guides to the path that leads straight to Him. When life's choices overwhelm you and you don't know what's right, call upon Ar-Rasheed — He will guide you not just to what's good, but to what's best.

data.name: الصَّبُورُ
data.reflection: He is endlessly patient with your struggles, your sins, and your slow progress. When you keep failing and feel like giving up on yourself, remember As-Saboor hasn't given up on you — He will wait as long as it takes.
